argvAssessment.preserved: Production NativeProcesses discovery is unchanged. Exact child lifetime, task/BSD generation/path checks, the actual selection wrappers and strict subsequent complete-row inclusion remain.
argvAssessment.privacy: Schema2 publishes bool/null comparisons, bounded counters and fixed classifications only. The private ACK is byte-bounded, exact-key checked and excludes environment fields; malformed/oversized input fails.
